Remains found after London wildfire; man arrested

The remains of a woman who vanished six or seven years ago have been discovered following a wildfire in London. A man has been arrested in connection with the discovery. The woman, identified as Joanne Sheen, was a mother of three. The wildfire revealed her remains.
